# sop-mnt-20 Lowercase Procedure

## Steps
1. Follow sop-mnt-9 before starting.
2. Use SOP–MNT–014 for closure (en dash).
3. Fill in FRM_MNT_221 as required.
4. Ignore ISO-9001 and UTF-8, which are standards not documents.
5. The template placeholder SOP-XXX-000 must not become a document.
6. Read SOP-MNT-009 Rev C section 4.2 first.
